sources.title: NaiveAI-Labs / Naive-N0.5-Flash Public - GitHub
sources.snippet: Introduction Naive-N0.5-Flash is an open-weight 309B MoE model with 15.5B active parameters, built for coding and AI R&D. It supports a native 1M-token context window through a hybrid of Sliding-Window Attention (SWA) and lightweight DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA), with no full-attention layers.

sources.title: JANGQ — Smaller Models, Bigger MLX Wins
sources.snippet: Curated JANGQ benchmarks showing only decisive wins where JANG is smaller than the MLX baseline: MiniMax +47.5 MMLU points, Qwen3.5-122B +33 points, and coherent smaller-bit runs on Mistral, Qwen2.5, SmolLM2, and TinyLlama.
